scope.exclusion_note: Excluded domains appear only as boundary nodes to prevent inappropriate transport of effect estimates.

conventions.effect_reporting: Absolute effects and 95% CI reported where available; 'unverified_at_source: true' marks figures not confirmed against primary full text during compilation (network egress restriction).
conventions.safety_rule: Absence of evidence of harm is never encoded as REDUCES or as a safety endorsement; it is encoded as HAS_UNCERTAIN_EFFECT_ON plus LIMITED_BY.
conventions.generalisation_rule: Effects are attached to the specific procedure/population node in which they were demonstrated; no cross-specialty inheritance.
